components.name: Daily Mission
components.description: A tinted working section for the next short practice session.
components.html:
Daily practice

Build the habit.
Follow the evidence.

A fresh mix of fundamentals and engineering decisions, with room to learn from every answer.

narrative.overview: A framed working sheet supports engineering practice and inspectable evidence. The light green-grey frame complements a neutral charcoal dark theme with restrained blue source actions. Flat surfaces, readable exercises and honest recorded activity remain central.
keyCharacteristics: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono
Light green-grey and neutral charcoal themes
Inspectable physical PDF pages and matching source quotes

rules.name: Flat working surfaces
rules.body: Use tint and thin borders to organize tasks. The implementation has no box-shadow vocabulary.

rules.name: Technical text stays legible
rules.body: Reserve compact metadata for supporting details; retain readable exercise and article type.

dos: Preserve focus outlines and reduced-motion support.
Reflow the pipeline and SQL selection at tablet widths.
Label reference dialects and simulations honestly.
donts: Do not add decorative gradients or glass effects.
Do not describe matching source quotes as proof of semantic correctness.
Do not imply account snapshots synchronize PDF documents or that real Llama inference has been verified.
Do not invent learner counts or proficiency claims.
Do not rely on feedback color alone.
